summary: The Town of Quarry Bend is asking for written quotations to replace two 100-gallon gas commercial water heaters and the recirculation pump at the Quarry Bend Recreation Center in Quarry Bend, Utah. The Town expects the cost to be about $48,000, the work must be done April 12 to April 23, 2027, and only small businesses may quote. Quotations are due by email by 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, March 16, 2027.

notes.text: Only small businesses may quote, and the Town uses its own definition: fewer than 100 employees. A firm must certify this on the Quotation Form to be considered.

The work must be done between April 12 and April 23, 2027, while the pool is closed. Quotations are due March 16, 2027, less than four weeks before that window opens, and the text does not say when the award will be made.

There is no scheduled site visit and no deadline for questions. A firm that wants to see the mechanical room before quoting can call the Recreation Center manager at (801) 555-0119. This reading treats that as optional.

Either licence is enough: Utah S210 General Plumbing Contractor or Utah S350 HVAC Contractor. The text does not ask for proof of the licence with the quotation. The text says "No bonds are required", read here as meaning neither a bid bond nor a performance bond. Proof of insurance is needed before starting work, not with the quotation.

Quotations go by email to the Town Clerk, but this section gives no email address. Section 5 lists the Town Clerk at clerk@quarrybend.example. The Town will award to the lowest quotation that meets the requirements.
